Compatibility: Avian

In combat, the psychological battle is as important as the physical one. This is known no better than those yahruda who have trained as “black-crests,” warriors with mastery over their own mind.

Like all creatures, yarhuda have a primal survival instinct. Unlike most though, yarhuda have found a way to tap into this power. Through complex mental techniques, yahruda have spent years training their mind to suppress and manage the psychological damage and instincts inherent in life-or-death situations—to feel nothing from combat. The pinnacle of this capability comes from true black-crests who, having let their other traits atrophy, have mastered a self-hypnotizing technique to distance themselves from combat unfolding before them.

Black-crests are so named because the focus required to enter this trance causes the yahruda’s head feathers to stand up straight, creating a crest. They enter this state by tapping a fiery deep well of heightened emotion, often a primal rage. Wielding this burning emotion, they shut out the world and put every part of it into the execution of their techniques. They willingly give up objectivity and trust, instead, that they chose the right time and place to enter the trance.

As a result, not just anyone can become black-crested. To shut out the world and rely purely on instincts requires a will of steel, and not all yahruda have that. But those that can, they are often feared and respected in equal volume. To their allies, they are brave and wise warriors trained to withstand the mental tolls of war. To their enemies, they are dead-eyed, unreasoning terrors cutting a path through the battlefield.
